notes: fw v0.1.2 — the zero-typing provisioning firmware: WiFi-only first-boot form, POST /provision, + all audit repairs + the TFT block protocol.

bug_fixes: Display commands now use the .txt= form the panel accepts - the clock/date/AMPM render live instead of a frozen placeholder
The updater used the wrong parameter order in the display-reflash command (baud where the file size belongs) - the reflash never started
The display-reflash now follows the complete per-block handshake - no more uploads stuck at 95%
Touch behavior: presses no longer jump the screen mid-interaction; the screensaver wakes on release
A malformed UART read could crash the touch decoder - guarded
The config storage is verified before erase (no blank-filesystem loop)
Commands are matched by their exact JSON field - stray mentions no longer trigger actions
The adopted OTA address is validated (dotted-quad) before use
features: Zero-typing provisioning: the first-boot form asks only for WiFi; the app pushes the MQTT settings after you accept the panel
POST /provision endpoint on the panel - the app's push channel for settings
mDNS + a status JSON the app can discover panels by
